scope: Intrinsic component-number return from tame geometric inertia of orders four and six, with a type-IV isogeny boundary control. Written arithmetic imports are separate from Lean integral algebra. No eta, normalized tamFactor or named-source ablation is supplied.

nicaise.checked_result: Corollary 3.3(2), printed page 7: elliptic Jacobian, delta=1, purely additive and tame gives geometric component order P_tau(1). Theorem 2.8 and its dependency correction remark were also read.

edixhoven.checked_result: Equations (2.2)-(2.4), printed page 31: prime-to-residue-characteristic component group is torsion in inertia cohomology, equivalently torsion coinvariants with Tate twist (-1).

isogeny_control.integral_T11_inverse: (1/3) times the dual isogeny; three is an eleven-adic unit
isogeny_control.boundary: Both non-CM models have type IV and discriminant valuation four at eleven, so neither is in the shallow II/III source scope. They have different rational component numbers but isomorphic full integral eleven-adic Galois Tate modules even with the Weil pairing retained. Isogeny preserves rational cohomology and L-functions; other integral/global BSD inputs are not frozen.
isogeny_control.polarized_T11_normalization: The Weil-pairing similitude multiplier is three. Compatible digit lifting from the simple residue root five constructs alpha in Z_11 with alpha^2=3. Rescaling the isogeny Tate map by alpha^-1 preserves the Weil pairing and full Galois action.

deduction_boundary: Geometric component order equals determinant(1-tau) under the checked tame purely additive hypotheses. Rational component number is Frobenius fixed-point order; for orders one and two this equals geometric order automatically. Order-three and type-IV controls show this equality cannot be extrapolated. Finite geometric inertia on ell-adic cohomology for ell unequal to the residue characteristic must not be confused with the generally infinite p-adic Galois inertia action. OC map normalization, sha_p hypotheses and complete named-source comparisons remain open.
